verdict.rationale: Working Copy offers some batch-style features (a conflict-resolve tool for many files at once, hunk-level staging, Shortcuts automation, and a Repository Agent AI that can browse/search/modify/commit/push) but nothing documented supports true bulk operations across many items (e.g., many repositories, many files via a single command, or scripted mass changes) at once. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operation tooling across multiple repos or large file sets, API/CLI-level batch commands, and any independent evidence of large-scale automation use.
